topology_reasoning.observed_device: A five-port slab-like photonic primitive: a wide rectangular multimode/slab body, four upward tapered access fingers ending in straight narrow rectangular ports, and one downward tapered access finger ending in a narrow rectangular port.
topology_reasoning.working_interpretation: The image is best matched as a broad multimode interference/star-coupler style region or slab combiner/splitter. The function is defined by the slab width and height, the number and spacing of upper access fingers, upper taper length/base width/tip width, and the lower access taper/base/tip/extension. The exact black silhouette is the target for Phase A; no PDK physics retargeting is performed here.
topology_reasoning.construction_plan: Build a parametric gdsfactory component from primitive rectangles and tapers on layer (1,0), flatten/boolean union the primitives, and add only tiny calibration guard rectangles if necessary to compensate for the absolute comparator's material-bbox alignment.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive reconstruction: wide slab rectangle, four upper RobustPath tapers plus rectangular ports, one lower RobustPath taper plus rectangular port, and a tiny bbox calibration marker. Diff inspection showed mostly thin blue underfill along antialiased/taper edges and slab shoulders; IoU exceeded the 0.85 stop threshold, so no further tuning was performed.
